The man agrees until he learns that he must also take Ruth, and then gives up his right, confirming it by handing over his sandal. Boaz buys the land and takes Ruth as his wife, and the women bless Naomi when Ruth bears Obed, who becomes the father of Jesse and the grandfather of David.
